These are the places in openmrs-esm-patient-chart that call `useVisit` (or depend on it) and could be affected by a behaviour change. I took the line numbers from a text search and did not open the files. The ranges are therefore narrow windows around each call, not whole functions. I did not look at `useVisit` in openmrs-esm-core itself.

**Production code that calls `useVisit`**
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-chart/patient-chart.resources.ts:94` passes `null` when the visit context is valid, so it is sensitive to how `useVisit` handles a missing patient.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/exported-visit-form.workspace.tsx:135` reads `activeVisit` and `isLoading`.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-form/visit-form.workspace.tsx:37` uses `mutate` to refresh the active visit.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/visit/visit-prompt/end-visit-dialog.modal.tsx:22` uses `activeVisit` and `mutate`.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/stop-visit.component.tsx:18` reads `activeVisit`.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/actions-buttons/delete-visit.component.tsx:18` reads `activeVisit`.
- `esm-patient-chart-app/src/patient-banner-tags/visit-attribute-tags.extension.tsx:37` reads `activeVisit`.
- `esm-patient-banner-app/src/banner-tags/visit-tag.extension.tsx:14` reads `activeVisit` and `isLoading`.

**Shared library code that depends on it**
- `esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/visit-mutations.ts:3` imports `useVisit` and `Visit`. I didn't check how it uses them.
- `esm-patient-common-lib/src/visit/revalidation-utils.ts:9` and `:87` have comments saying that more than 28 components use current visit data through `useVisit`. That means components not found by my search may also be affected.

**Tests that mock `useVisit`** (a changed return shape would break these mocks)
- `delete-visit.test.tsx`
- `stop-visit.test.tsx`
- `visit-form.test.tsx`
- `end-visit-dialog.test.tsx`
- `visit-attribute-tags.test.tsx`
- `patient-chart.resources.test.ts`
- `visit-tag.test.tsx`
- `immunizations-detailed-summary.test.tsx`
- `vitals-header.test.tsx`
